name: application-inputs
title: Inputs
description: Text input fields for forms, search bars, and data entry — with variants for icons, inline buttons, and animated floating labels.
useWhen: Collecting short free-text or search query input from users within a form or toolbar.
Adding an inline search input to a table header or filter bar.
Building form fields that need a supporting icon or integrated action button.
avoidWhen: Users need to enter multiple lines of text — use a textarea instead.
The input requires structured selection from a fixed set of options — use a select or combobox.
The value must match a specific format and should guide the user — consider a masked input or specialized date/number input.
responsiveBehavior: Inputs stretch to fill their container width at all viewport sizes. Stacked label-and-input pairs reflow gracefully in narrow containers.
accessibility: Every input must have an associated <label> linked via for/id or as a wrapping element.
Placeholder text is not a substitute for a label — placeholders disappear on focus and are not reliably announced.
Error messages must be associated with the input via aria-describedby so they are read aloud.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Standard bordered text input with an above label — the default building block for form fields.
accessibility: Label must be visually associated with the input; placeholder text is not a replacement for a label.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Standard bordered text input with label adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark input border and text must maintain WCAG AA contrast in all states.

variants.title: Base with icon
variants.description: Text input with a decorative or functional icon inside the field on the right, useful for search or type-hint indicators.
accessibility: Decorative icons inside inputs must have aria-hidden="true"; functional icons need an accessible label.

variants.title: Base with icon (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-adorned text input adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Icon color must contrast with the dark input background and not obscure the text cursor.

variants.title: Base with button
variants.description: Search input with an inline action button attached to the trailing edge — common for search bars and coupon fields.
accessibility: The button must have a descriptive label; pressing Enter in the input should also trigger the action.

variants.title: Base with button (Dark)
variants.description: Inline-action search input adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Button color contrast and focus ring must meet WCAG AA requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Floating label
variants.description: Input where the placeholder label animates upward on focus to sit above the field, preserving space when empty.
accessibility: Floating label must remain programmatically associated with the input at all states, not just the floated position.

variants.title: Floating label (Dark)
variants.description: Animated floating-label input adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Label text must contrast with the dark background in both its resting and floated positions.
